name: Tags
description: A named group of items, fluids or blocks shared by mods.

pages.title: Tags
pages.text:
A **tag** is a named group of items, fluids or blocks. Recipes and mods check the tag instead of one exact item, so different mods' versions work alike.\
\
Shared fluid tags let Blaze Burners burn TFMG fuels; the steel tag takes any steel. Glass in the greenhouse glass tag shelters crops.
